arguments.summary: Investigated the p99 latency spike and found it to be related to the connection pool exhaustion. The failed-jobs backlog in the jobs database has been growing, with 1,388 failed jobs and 47 malformed rows identified. The failed_jobs table has been exported for the postmortem. No services were restarted in prod without prior consultation.
arguments.recommended_next_step: Analyze the failed jobs to identify the root cause and implement measures to prevent future failures. Monitor the connection pool to ensure it can handle peak loads and adjust settings if necessary.
